scores.rationale: The candidate uses completely wrong frame names (`list_sessions` and `session_list` with a `sessions` field instead of `list_conversations` and `conversation_list` with `conversations`) and type names (`ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame` instead of `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, `ConversationSummary`). It directly violates multiple explicit requirements in the issue: it omits the `transport.history` opt-in configuration, fails to add `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` or `StoreCannotList`, and returns an empty list (`sessions: []`) when a store lacks `listFor` despite the ticket explicitly forbidding this. Furthermore, it introduces a prototype-pollution/inherited-property bug in `validation.ts` by indexing a plain object `validators[message.type]` without `Object.hasOwn` or a `Map` (so `type: 'toString'` will execute `Object.prototype.toString`), and allows `NaN`/`Infinity` when `before.updatedAt` is a number. Finally, it misses updating `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, `docs/getting-started.md`, and `CHANGELOG.md`.
